device_entry.description: 一款可编程协作机械臂，可通过图形化积木程序或 Python 脚本控制运动流程、关节动作和实验操作。常用于教学演示、实验室自动化、样品搬运及机械臂流程开发。
device_entry.description_en: A programmable collaborative robot arm that can be controlled through block-based programs or Python scripts for motion sequences, joint movements, and experimental operations. It is commonly used for teaching, laboratory automation, sample handling, and robot workflow development.

schema.description: 将机械臂的积木程序转换为 Python 控制脚本。
